identity.objective: Challenge whether Flow is reducible to the ten accepted RGR headings or earns consideration as an additional formal primitive, while preserving epistemic standing and zero runtime authority.

evidence_refs: Burger/Stone Esoteric Anatomy lineage supplied by Founder
CSF / respiration material supplied by Founder
assumptions: The ten RGR-02 primitive headings remain canonical during the challenge.
Cross-domain resemblance does not establish shared mechanism or ontology.
unknowns: Whether explicit Flow structure adds predictive or transfer value beyond matched dynamic alternatives.
Whether Weather is best represented as context, field modulation, dynamical regime, or no additional structure.
Whether Elemental operator families add value beyond non-elemental alternatives.

acceptance_conditions: Flow primitive standing remains CANDIDATE_UNESTABLISHED until challenge evidence and later Founder adjudication.
The derived-Flow model M0 is given a fair opportunity to defeat M1.
Weather and Elemental operator hypotheses remain separately typed and non-circular.
Burger/Stone, physiology, Elemental Alchemy, and first-person experience retain separate source standing.
No MAIA runtime, member memory, schema, migration, or deployment change occurs.
falsification_conditions: Flow is promoted by rhetoric rather than irreducibility evidence.
M0 is handicapped by denying matched dynamic representational capacity.
Elemental labels define the primary Flow benchmark.
Esoteric and physiological flow are treated as one established mechanism.
A runtime change appears before separate Founder authorization.
stop_conditions: Member/private/PHI data becomes necessary for Stage 05A.
The challenge cannot distinguish Flow from ordinary dynamic-system variables without circular definitions.

guard.authorized_core_snapshot: RGR-05 bounded documentary/formal challenge; no runtime or member-facing authority.

execution_note: Stage 05A only. No RGR-02 rewrite, runtime integration, persistence, schema, migration, deployment, or member-facing Flow inference is authorized.
